title: About
text: ## Life up until now I grew up in Toronto and went to UWaterloo for undergrad like many other people. The summer after graduation was the only break I had before transitioning into the master’s program. Before that, I mainly worked in multiple internships within the fintech industry.

title: Steven Mou
text: Hi. I’m Steven, I’m from Toronto, and I’m currently pursuing a Master of Data Science at UBC. I previously went to the University of Waterloo where I did my undergrad for Computer Science and Finance. I’m always looking for more experiences and opportunities as I work towards becoming more technically complete.

title: About
text: It was actually my previous internships that first sparked my interest in data science. Working with a lot of financial data, it really drove home that data is the underlying factor of everything. I wanted to learn more about how I can create with data. Also, it wouldn’t hurt to try to experience a new life in Vancouver.
